merge_semantics: Shallow-merge field_overrides into fields, target_default_overrides into target_defaults, and site_requirement_overrides into site_requirements; preserve all other generated keys.

administrative_aufnahmeinformationen.auf.reason: AKTIN confirmed that the emergency-department collection time may populate the Allergy Concern Act start; this reviewed mapping uses Aufnahmezeitpunkt and must not activate an otherwise absent allergy branch.

transform.reason: DEC-042 records a finite target-scoped bridge while the exact 2019 DIVI CodeSystem included by this target ValueSet remains unavailable; this does not complete or alias that terminology artifact.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.1.reason: The exact source option carries the owner terminology association to code 1 in the CodeSystem named by the target ValueSet include.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.2.reason: The exact source option carries the owner terminology association to code 3 in the CodeSystem named by the target ValueSet include.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.11.reason: Reviewed cross-revision assumption: the selected transaction has this exact 2024 option association and the newer owner referral-actions ValueSet explicitly enumerates code 7, but membership in the unavailable 2019 CodeSystem revision is not claimed.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.3.reason: The exact source option carries the owner terminology association to code 5 in the CodeSystem named by the target ValueSet include.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.10.reason: The source option is associated with SNOMED CT, but that system is not proven inside the older target binding and no single legacy referral destination can be selected; OTH preserves the exact source wording in originalText.

2.16.840.1.113883.2.6.60.3.2.6.20021.7.reason: The exact source option carries the owner HL7 NullFlavor OTH association; the reviewed target CE permits nullFlavor and exposes originalText for the source wording.

Allergyintoleranceobservation.effectiveT.reason: The host transaction does not provide the allergy onset; AKTIN confirmed that the required Allergy Intolerance Observation effectiveTime may therefore carry nullFlavor UNK.

Allergyintoleranceobservation.statusCode.reason: This is the status of the Allergy Intolerance Observation assertion, not whether the allergy or concern has ended. The active template examples consistently represent the completed assertion with ActStatus completed.

Problemconcernactcedis.statusCode.reason: The presenting complaint is represented as an actively tracked concern; completed requires explicit closure evidence and a corresponding concern effectiveTime.high.

Problemconcernacteddiagnoses.statusCode.reason: The final-diagnosis Concern Act represents diagnoses that remain clinically relevant for handoff. The transaction contains no concern-closure datum; completed requires explicit evidence that tracking ended and a corresponding concern effectiveTime.high.

Problemconcernacteddiagnoses.low.reason: The transaction does not provide when the final-diagnosis concern became active; the applicable concern-start time exists but is unknown.

Problemobservationeddiagnosis.code.reason: This element identifies the statement as a diagnosis observation. The template explicitly prefers LOINC 29308-4 over 75324-4.

CDAauthor.assignedPerson::PersonElements.reason: The document author identity is deployment configuration and completes the active author participation.

CDAconfidentialityCode.confidentialityCo.reason: Document confidentiality is deployment policy and must be supplied by the site.

CDAlanguageCode.languageCode.reason: Document language is deployment configuration and must be supplied by the site.

Medikation.moodCode.reason: Medication mood depends on the local source and export semantics and must be supplied for each active medication entry.
